capabilities: Preview Markdown notes as WeChat articles
Send the current note to WeChat drafts
Render image-post card decks as PNGs
Check notes for missing images before publishing
Copy rich text and show publish progress
disambiguation: Not a general website or blog publisher; it sends Markdown notes to WeChat Official Account drafts.
extras: Hosted subscriptions, a universal installer and a Community Directory listing are not available; the CLI is a source build and draft delivery needs a server with a stable outbound IP.
problem: Publishing Markdown notes to WeChat Official Account drafts normally means leaving Obsidian and copying content into a browser.

relations.evidence: renders and delivers the current note to WeChat drafts in place

summary: Markdown-to-WeChat draft publisher that previews notes in Obsidian and sends them to a WeChat Official Account draft box.
